rule: At least 1 recovery day per week
summary: One retrospective cohort of top endurance athletes links fewer than 2 rest days a week to 5x overuse-injury risk; no trial sets the count for concurrent training. 1 recovery day is the floor, not a target; watch it if training volume rises.

sources.note: Ristolainen 2014 (446 top endurance athletes): <2 rest days/wk had 5.2x overuse-injury risk (retrospective)
Bishop 2008 review: recovery between workouts is a planned part of training
